module Grisette.Lib.Synth.Context
type MonadContext (ctx :: Type -> Type) = (MonadError Text ctx, TryMerge ctx)
type MonadSymbolicContext (ctx :: Type -> Type) = (MonadContext ctx, MonadUnion ctx)
type MonadAngelicContext (ctx :: Type -> Type) = (MonadSymbolicContext ctx, MonadFresh ctx)

-- | A concrete context is a context that does not do multi-path symbolic
--   execution.
type ConcreteContext = Either Text

-- | A symbolic context is a context that does multi-path symbolic
--   execution.
type SymbolicContext = ExceptT Text Union

-- | An angelic context is a context that does multi-path symbolic
--   execution with angelic choices.
type AngelicContext = FreshT ExceptT Text Union

module Grisette.Lib.Synth.Util.Pretty
encloseListIfNotSingle :: Doc ann -> Doc ann -> Doc ann -> [Doc ann] -> Doc ann
encloseList :: Doc ann -> Doc ann -> Doc ann -> [Doc ann] -> Doc ann
renderDoc :: Int -> Doc ann -> Text

-- | The abstract data type <tt><a>Doc</a> ann</tt> represents pretty
--   documents that have been annotated with data of type <tt>ann</tt>.
--   
--   More specifically, a value of type <tt><a>Doc</a></tt> represents a
--   non-empty set of possible layouts of a document. The layout functions
--   select one of these possibilities, taking into account things like the
--   width of the output document.
--   
--   The annotation is an arbitrary piece of data associated with (part of)
--   a document. Annotations may be used by the rendering backends in order
--   to display output differently, such as
--   
--   <ul>
--   <li>color information (e.g. when rendering to the terminal)</li>
--   <li>mouseover text (e.g. when rendering to rich HTML)</li>
--   <li>whether to show something or not (to allow simple or detailed
--   versions)</li>
--   </ul>
--   
--   The simplest way to display a <a>Doc</a> is via the <a>Show</a> class.
--   
--   <pre>
--   &gt;&gt;&gt; putStrLn (show (vsep ["hello", "world"]))
--   hello
--   world
--   </pre>
data Doc ann

-- | <tt>(x <a>&lt;+&gt;</a> y)</tt> concatenates document <tt>x</tt> and
--   <tt>y</tt> with a <tt><tt>space</tt></tt> in between.
--   
--   <pre>
--   &gt;&gt;&gt; "hello" &lt;+&gt; "world"
--   hello world
--   </pre>
--   
--   <pre>
--   x <a>&lt;+&gt;</a> y = x <a>&lt;&gt;</a> <tt>space</tt> <a>&lt;&gt;</a> y
--   </pre>
(<+>) :: Doc ann -> Doc ann -> Doc ann
infixr 6 <+>

-- | <tt>(<a>nest</a> i x)</tt> lays out the document <tt>x</tt> with the
--   current nesting level (indentation of the following lines) increased
--   by <tt>i</tt>. Negative values are allowed, and decrease the nesting
--   level accordingly.
--   
--   <pre>
--   &gt;&gt;&gt; vsep [nest 4 (vsep ["lorem", "ipsum", "dolor"]), "sit", "amet"]
--   lorem
--       ipsum
--       dolor
--   sit
--   amet
--   </pre>
--   
--   See also
--   
--   <ul>
--   <li><a>hang</a> (<a>nest</a> relative to current cursor position
--   instead of current nesting level)</li>
--   <li><a>align</a> (set nesting level to current cursor position)</li>
--   <li><a>indent</a> (increase indentation on the spot, padding with
--   spaces).</li>
--   </ul>
nest :: Int -> Doc ann -> Doc ann

-- | Concatenate all documents element-wise with a binary function.
--   
--   <pre>
--   <a>concatWith</a> _ [] = <a>mempty</a>
--   <a>concatWith</a> (**) [x,y,z] = x ** y ** z
--   </pre>
--   
--   Multiple convenience definitions based on <a>concatWith</a> are
--   already predefined, for example:
--   
--   <pre>
--   <a>hsep</a>    = <a>concatWith</a> (<a>&lt;+&gt;</a>)
--   <a>fillSep</a> = <a>concatWith</a> (\x y -&gt; x <a>&lt;&gt;</a> <a>softline</a> <a>&lt;&gt;</a> y)
--   </pre>
--   
--   This is also useful to define customized joiners:
--   
--   <pre>
--   &gt;&gt;&gt; concatWith (surround dot) ["Prettyprinter", "Render", "Text"]
--   Prettyprinter.Render.Text
--   </pre>
concatWith :: Foldable t => (Doc ann -> Doc ann -> Doc ann) -> t (Doc ann) -> Doc ann

-- | A <tt><a>hardline</a></tt> is <i>always</i> laid out as a line break,
--   even when <a>group</a>ed or when there is plenty of space. Note that
--   it might still be simply discarded if it is part of a <a>flatAlt</a>
--   inside a <a>group</a>.
--   
--   <pre>
--   &gt;&gt;&gt; let doc = "lorem ipsum" &lt;&gt; hardline &lt;&gt; "dolor sit amet"
--   
--   &gt;&gt;&gt; putDocW 1000 doc
--   lorem ipsum
--   dolor sit amet
--   </pre>
--   
--   <pre>
--   &gt;&gt;&gt; group doc
--   lorem ipsum
--   dolor sit amet
--   </pre>
hardline :: Doc ann
parenCommaListIfNotSingle :: [Doc ann] -> Doc ann
parenCommaList :: [Doc ann] -> Doc ann

-- | <tt>(<a>vsep</a> xs)</tt> concatenates all documents <tt>xs</tt> above
--   each other. If a <a>group</a> undoes the line breaks inserted by
--   <tt>vsep</tt>, the documents are separated with a <tt>space</tt>
--   instead.
--   
--   Using <a>vsep</a> alone yields
--   
--   <pre>
--   &gt;&gt;&gt; "prefix" &lt;+&gt; vsep ["text", "to", "lay", "out"]
--   prefix text
--   to
--   lay
--   out
--   </pre>
--   
--   <a>group</a>ing a <a>vsep</a> separates the documents with a
--   <tt>space</tt> if it fits the page (and does nothing otherwise). See
--   the <tt><a>sep</a></tt> convenience function for this use case.
--   
--   The <a>align</a> function can be used to align the documents under
--   their first element:
--   
--   <pre>
--   &gt;&gt;&gt; "prefix" &lt;+&gt; align (vsep ["text", "to", "lay", "out"])
--   prefix text
--          to
--          lay
--          out
--   </pre>
--   
--   Since <a>group</a>ing a <a>vsep</a> is rather common, <a>sep</a> is a
--   built-in for doing that.
vsep :: [Doc ann] -> Doc ann

-- | <tt>(<a>vcat</a> xs)</tt> vertically concatenates the documents
--   <tt>xs</tt>. If it is <a>group</a>ed, the line breaks are removed.
--   
--   In other words <tt><a>vcat</a></tt> is like <tt><a>vsep</a></tt>, with
--   newlines removed instead of replaced by <tt>space</tt>s.
--   
--   <pre>
--   &gt;&gt;&gt; let docs = Util.words "lorem ipsum dolor"
--   
--   &gt;&gt;&gt; vcat docs
--   lorem
--   ipsum
--   dolor
--   
--   &gt;&gt;&gt; group (vcat docs)
--   loremipsumdolor
--   </pre>
--   
--   Since <a>group</a>ing a <a>vcat</a> is rather common, <a>cat</a> is a
--   built-in shortcut for it.
vcat :: [Doc ann] -> Doc ann

module Grisette.Lib.Synth.Util.Logging
logMultiLine :: Logger -> Priority -> String -> IO ()
logMultiLineText :: Logger -> Priority -> Text -> IO ()
logMultiLineDoc :: Logger -> Priority -> Doc ann -> IO ()
logMultiLinePretty :: PPrint a => Logger -> Priority -> a -> IO ()

module Grisette.Lib.Synth.VarId
type ConcreteVarId varId = (PPrint varId, Show varId, Eq varId, Hashable varId, Integral varId, Typeable varId, Mergeable varId)
type SymbolicVarId varId = (Show varId, Eq varId, Num varId, SymOrd varId, Mergeable varId, Typeable varId, GenSymSimple () varId)
type RelatedVarId conVarId symVarId = (ConcreteVarId conVarId, SymbolicVarId symVarId, ToSym conVarId symVarId, ToCon symVarId conVarId)

module Grisette.Lib.Synth.Program.Concrete.OpPPrint
type VarIdMap varId = HashMap varId Text
data OpPPrintError varId op
IncorrectNumberOfArguments :: op -> Int -> Int -> OpPPrintError varId op
UndefinedArgument :: Int -> varId -> OpPPrintError varId op

class PrefixByType ty
prefixByType :: PrefixByType ty => ty -> Text
class OpPPrint op
prefixResults :: OpPPrint op => op -> Either (OpPPrintError varId op) [Text]

($dmdescribeArguments) :: (OpPPrint op, OpTyping op ConcreteContext) => op -> Either (OpPPrintError varId op) [Maybe Text]
pformatOp :: OpPPrint op => op -> Doc ann
($dmpformatOp) :: (OpPPrint op, PPrint op) => op -> Doc ann
prettyArguments :: (ConcreteVarId varId, OpPPrint op) => op -> [varId] -> VarIdMap varId -> Either (OpPPrintError varId op) (Doc ann)
prettyResults :: (ConcreteVarId varId, OpPPrint op) => op -> [varId] -> VarIdMap varId -> Either (OpPPrintError varId op) (VarIdMap varId, Doc ann)

module Grisette.Lib.Synth.Program.ProgParser

progTableParser :: (CharParser e s m, ProgParser prog) => m (SymbolTable prog)

module Grisette.Lib.Synth.Program.ProgCost
class MonadContext ctx => ProgCost costObj prog cost (ctx :: Type -> Type)
progCost :: ProgCost costObj prog cost ctx => costObj -> SymbolCostTable cost ctx -> prog -> ctx cost
newtype SymbolCostTable cost (ctx :: Type -> Type)
SymbolCostTable :: [(Text, ctx cost)] -> SymbolCostTable cost (ctx :: Type -> Type)
symbolCostTable :: forall costObj prog cost (ctx :: Type -> Type). ProgCost costObj prog cost ctx => costObj -> SymbolTable prog -> SymbolCostTable cost ctx
lookupCost :: (MonadContext ctx, Mergeable cost) => SymbolCostTable cost ctx -> Text -> ctx cost
symbolCost :: (MonadContext ctx, Mergeable cost, ProgCost costObj prog cost ctx) => costObj -> SymbolTable prog -> Text -> ctx cost
instance GHC.Internal.Base.Monoid (Grisette.Lib.Synth.Program.ProgCost.SymbolCostTable cost ctx)
instance GHC.Internal.Base.Semigroup (Grisette.Lib.Synth.Program.ProgCost.SymbolCostTable cost ctx)

module Grisette.Lib.Synth.Program.CostModel.PerStmtCostModel
newtype PerStmtCostObj opCostObj
PerStmtCostObj :: opCostObj -> PerStmtCostObj opCostObj
class MonadContext ctx => OpCost opCostObj op cost (ctx :: Type -> Type)
opCost :: OpCost opCostObj op cost ctx => opCostObj -> SymbolCostTable cost ctx -> op -> ctx cost
instance (Grisette.Internal.Core.Control.Monad.Class.Union.MonadUnion ctx, Grisette.Lib.Synth.Program.CostModel.PerStmtCostModel.OpCost opCostObj op cost ctx, Grisette.Internal.Internal.Decl.Core.Data.Class.Mergeable.Mergeable op) => Grisette.Lib.Synth.Program.CostModel.PerStmtCostModel.OpCost opCostObj (Grisette.Internal.Internal.Decl.Core.Control.Monad.Union.Union op) cost ctx

module Grisette.Lib.Synth.Program.CostModel.NoCostModel
data NoCostObj
NoCostObj :: NoCostObj
instance (Grisette.Lib.Synth.Context.MonadContext ctx, Grisette.Internal.Internal.Decl.Core.Data.Class.Mergeable.Mergeable cost, GHC.Internal.Num.Num cost) => Grisette.Lib.Synth.Program.ProgCost.ProgCost Grisette.Lib.Synth.Program.CostModel.NoCostModel.NoCostObj prog cost ctx


-- | Do not use plain concrete programs on operators that may generate
--   multiple results that cannot be merged into a single result, or there
--   can be significant performance issues.
--   
--   Use the <tt>ProgMayMultiPath</tt> wrapper to allow multiple results.
--   However, note that it is generally not a good idea to use
--   non-simply-mergeable types as results, as it can lead to exponential
--   blowup in the number of results.
module Grisette.Lib.Synth.Program.Concrete.Program
data Stmt op varId
Stmt :: op -> [varId] -> [varId] -> Stmt op varId
[stmtOp] :: Stmt op varId -> op
[stmtArgIds] :: Stmt op varId -> [varId]
[stmtResIds] :: Stmt op varId -> [varId]
data ProgArg varId ty
ProgArg :: Text -> varId -> ty -> ProgArg varId ty
[progArgName] :: ProgArg varId ty -> Text
[progArgId] :: ProgArg varId ty -> varId
[progArgType] :: ProgArg varId ty -> ty
data ProgRes varId ty
ProgRes :: varId -> ty -> ProgRes varId ty
[progResId] :: ProgRes varId ty -> varId
[progResType] :: ProgRes varId ty -> ty
data Prog op varId ty
Prog :: [ProgArg varId ty] -> [Stmt op varId] -> [ProgRes varId ty] -> Prog op varId ty
[progArgList] :: Prog op varId ty -> [ProgArg varId ty]
[progStmtList] :: Prog op varId ty -> [Stmt op varId]
[progResList] :: Prog op varId ty -> [ProgRes varId ty]
data ProgPPrintError varId op
StmtPPrintError :: Stmt op varId -> Int -> OpPPrintError varId op -> ProgPPrintError varId op
ResultUndefined :: Int -> varId -> ProgPPrintError varId op
ExtractSubProgError :: Text -> ProgPPrintError varId op
prettyStmt :: (ConcreteVarId varId, OpPPrint op) => Int -> Stmt op varId -> StateT (VarIdMap varId) (Either (ProgPPrintError varId op)) (Doc ann)
prettyProg :: (ConcreteVarId varId, OpPPrint op, PPrint ty) => Text -> Prog op varId ty -> Either (ProgPPrintError varId op) (Doc ann)
stmtToDotNode :: (ConcreteVarId varId, OpPPrint op) => Text -> Int -> Stmt op varId -> StateT (VarIdToLabel varId) (Either (ProgPPrintError varId op)) (DotNode Text, [DotEdge Text])
progToDotSubGraph :: (ConcreteVarId varId, OpPPrint op, PPrint ty) => Text -> Prog op varId ty -> Either (ProgPPrintError varId op) (DotSubGraph Text)
class ProgPPrint prog
pformatProg :: ProgPPrint prog => Text -> prog -> Either (Doc ann) (Doc ann)
class ProgToDot prog
toDotProg :: ProgToDot prog => Text -> prog -> DotSubGraph Text
eliminateDeadCode :: ConcreteVarId varId => Prog op varId ty -> Prog op varId ty

module Grisette.Lib.Synth.Reasoning.Synthesis
class SynthesisContext (ctx :: Type -> Type)
genSynthesisConstraint :: (SynthesisContext ctx, Matcher matcher SymBool val, Mergeable val) => matcher -> ctx [val] -> [val] -> IO SymBool
data SynthesisResult conProg
SynthesisSuccess :: SymbolTable conProg -> SynthesisResult conProg
SynthesisVerifierFailure :: Text -> SynthesisResult conProg
SynthesisSolverFailure :: SolvingFailure -> SynthesisResult conProg
class IsVerifier verifier symProg conProg | verifier -> symProg conProg
toVerifierFuns :: IsVerifier verifier symProg conProg => verifier -> SymbolTable symProg -> Text -> [VerifierFun (SomeExample symProg conProg) Text]
data SomeVerifier symProg conProg
[SomeVerifier] :: forall verifier symProg conProg. IsVerifier verifier symProg conProg => verifier -> SomeVerifier symProg conProg
data Example symSemObj symVal conSemObj conVal matcher
[Example] :: forall conSemObj symSemObj symVal conVal matcher. conSemObj -> symSemObj -> Proxy symVal -> IOPair conVal -> matcher -> Example symSemObj symVal conSemObj conVal matcher
type SymExampleConstraint symSemObj symProg symVal matcher = (ProgSemantics symSemObj symProg symVal AngelicContext, ProgUtil symProg, Matcher matcher SymBool symVal, Mergeable symVal, Eq symSemObj, Eq matcher, Typeable symSemObj, Typeable symProg, Typeable symVal, Typeable matcher, NFData symSemObj, NFData matcher)
type ConExampleConstraint conSemObj conProg conVal matcher = (ProgSemantics conSemObj conProg conVal ConcreteContext, ProgUtil conProg, Matcher matcher Bool conVal, Mergeable conVal, Eq conSemObj, Eq matcher, Eq conVal, Mergeable conVal, Show conVal, PPrint conVal, Typeable conSemObj, Typeable conProg, Typeable conVal, Typeable matcher, NFData conSemObj, NFData matcher, NFData conVal)
data SomeExample symProg conProg
[SomeExample] :: forall symSemObj symProg symVal conSemObj conProg conVal matcher. (SymExampleConstraint symSemObj symProg symVal matcher, ConExampleConstraint conSemObj conProg conVal matcher, ToSym conVal symVal) => Example symSemObj symVal conSemObj conVal matcher -> SomeExample symProg conProg
synthesisConstraintFun :: Typeable symProg => SymbolTable symProg -> Text -> SynthesisConstraintFun (SomeExample symProg conProg)
class RunSynthesisTask task symProg conProg | task -> symProg conProg
solverRunSynthesisTaskExtractCex :: (RunSynthesisTask task symProg conProg, Solver solver) => solver -> task -> IO ([SomeExample symProg conProg], SynthesisResult conProg)
taskRefinable :: RunSynthesisTask task symProg conProg => task -> Bool
solverRunSynthesisTask :: (Solver solver, RunSynthesisTask task symProg conProg) => solver -> task -> IO (SynthesisResult conProg)
runSynthesisTask :: (ConfigurableSolver config h, RunSynthesisTask task symProg conProg) => config -> task -> IO (SynthesisResult conProg)
runSynthesisTaskExtractCex :: (ConfigurableSolver config h, RunSynthesisTask task symProg conProg) => config -> task -> IO ([SomeExample symProg conProg], SynthesisResult conProg)
data SynthesisTask symProg conProg
[SynthesisTask] :: forall symProg conProg. (EvalSym symProg, ToCon symProg conProg, Typeable symProg, ProgReachableSymbols conProg) => [SomeVerifier symProg conProg] -> [SomeExample symProg conProg] -> SymbolTable symProg -> Text -> SymBool -> SynthesisConstraintFun (SomeExample symProg conProg) -> SynthesisTask symProg conProg
data SynthesisBoundCostTask symProg conProg
[SynthesisBoundCostTask] :: forall symProg conProg cost symCostObj. (EvalSym symProg, ToCon symProg conProg, ProgReachableSymbols conProg, ProgCost symCostObj symProg cost AngelicContext, SymOrd cost, Mergeable cost) => [SomeVerifier symProg conProg] -> [SomeExample symProg conProg] -> SymbolTable symProg -> Text -> SymBool -> Maybe cost -> symCostObj -> SynthesisConstraintFun (SomeExample symProg conProg) -> SynthesisBoundCostTask symProg conProg
data SynthesisMinimalCostTask symProg conProg
[SynthesisMinimalCostTask] :: forall symProg conProg cost conCostObj symCostObj. (EvalSym symProg, ToCon symProg conProg, ProgReachableSymbols conProg, ProgCost conCostObj conProg cost ConcreteContext, ProgCost symCostObj symProg cost AngelicContext, SymOrd cost, Mergeable cost) => [SomeVerifier symProg conProg] -> [SomeExample symProg conProg] -> SymbolTable symProg -> Text -> SymBool -> Maybe cost -> conCostObj -> symCostObj -> SynthesisConstraintFun (SomeExample symProg conProg) -> SynthesisMinimalCostTask symProg conProg
instance (Data.Bytes.Serial.Serial a1, Data.Bytes.Serial.Serial a2, Data.Bytes.Serial.Serial a3, Data.Bytes.Serial.Serial a4) => Data.Binary.Class.Binary (Grisette.Lib.Synth.Reasoning.Synthesis.Example a1 a5 a2 a3 a4)
instance Data.Bytes.Serial.Serial a => Data.Binary.Class.Binary (Grisette.Lib.Synth.Reasoning.Synthesis.SynthesisResult a)
instance (GHC.Classes.Eq a1, GHC.Classes.Eq a2, GHC.Classes.Eq a3, GHC.Classes.Eq a4) => GHC.Classes.Eq (Grisette.Lib.Synth.Reasoning.Synthesis.Example a1 a5 a2 a3 a4)

module Grisette.Lib.Synth.Reasoning.Verification
data SMTVerifier symVal conVal symProg conProg
[SMTVerifier] :: forall symSemObj symProg symVal matcher conSemObj conProg conVal. (SymExampleConstraint symSemObj symProg symVal matcher, ConExampleConstraint conSemObj conProg conVal matcher, ProgSemantics conSemObj conProg symVal SymbolicContext, Mergeable matcher, EvalSym matcher) => GrisetteSMTConfig -> Maybe Seconds -> symSemObj -> conSemObj -> [AngelicContext [symVal]] -> ([symVal] -> SymbolicContext ([symVal], matcher)) -> SMTVerifier symVal conVal symProg conProg
defaultSMTVerifier :: forall conVal symVal conProg symProg semObj. (SymExampleConstraint semObj symProg symVal EqMatcher, ConExampleConstraint semObj conProg conVal EqMatcher, EvalSym symProg, Mergeable symVal, ToCon symVal conVal, EvalSym symVal, ToSym conVal symVal, ToCon symProg conProg, ProgSemantics semObj conProg symVal SymbolicContext, Show symVal) => semObj -> GrisetteSMTConfig -> Maybe Seconds -> [AngelicContext [symVal]] -> ([symVal] -> SymbolicContext [symVal]) -> SomeVerifier symProg conProg
defaultSemSMTVerifier :: forall conVal symVal conProg symProg. (SymExampleConstraint DefaultSem symProg symVal EqMatcher, ConExampleConstraint DefaultSem conProg conVal EqMatcher, EvalSym symProg, Mergeable symVal, ToCon symVal conVal, EvalSym symVal, ToSym conVal symVal, ToCon symProg conProg, ProgSemantics DefaultSem conProg symVal SymbolicContext, Show symVal) => GrisetteSMTConfig -> Maybe Seconds -> [AngelicContext [symVal]] -> ([symVal] -> SymbolicContext [symVal]) -> SomeVerifier symProg conProg
instance (Grisette.Internal.Internal.Decl.Core.Data.Class.EvalSym.EvalSym symProg, Grisette.Internal.Internal.Decl.Core.Data.Class.Mergeable.Mergeable symVal, Grisette.Internal.Internal.Decl.Core.Data.Class.ToCon.ToCon symVal conVal, Grisette.Internal.Internal.Decl.Core.Data.Class.EvalSym.EvalSym symVal, Grisette.Internal.Internal.Decl.Core.Data.Class.ToSym.ToSym conVal symVal, Grisette.Internal.Internal.Decl.Core.Data.Class.ToCon.ToCon symProg conProg, GHC.Internal.Show.Show symVal) => Grisette.Lib.Synth.Reasoning.Synthesis.IsVerifier (Grisette.Lib.Synth.Reasoning.Verification.SMTVerifier symVal conVal symProg conProg) symProg conProg

Stmt :: op -> [symVarId] -> symVarId -> [symVarId] -> symVarId -> SymBool -> [symVarId] -> Stmt op symVarId
[stmtOp] :: Stmt op symVarId -> op
[stmtArgIds] :: Stmt op symVarId -> [symVarId]
[stmtArgNum] :: Stmt op symVarId -> symVarId
[stmtResIds] :: Stmt op symVarId -> [symVarId]

[stmtDisabled] :: Stmt op symVarId -> SymBool
[stmtMustBeAfter] :: Stmt op symVarId -> [symVarId]
data ProgArg ty
ProgArg :: Text -> ty -> ProgArg ty
[progArgName] :: ProgArg ty -> Text
[progArgType] :: ProgArg ty -> ty
data ProgRes symVarId ty
ProgRes :: symVarId -> ty -> ProgRes symVarId ty
[progResId] :: ProgRes symVarId ty -> symVarId
[progResType] :: ProgRes symVarId ty -> ty
data Prog op symVarId ty
Prog :: [ProgArg ty] -> [Stmt op symVarId] -> [ProgRes symVarId ty] -> Prog op symVarId ty
[progArgList] :: Prog op symVarId ty -> [ProgArg ty]
[progStmtList] :: Prog op symVarId ty -> [Stmt op symVarId]
[progResList] :: Prog op symVarId ty -> [ProgRes symVarId ty]

module Grisette.Lib.Synth.Program.ComponentSketch.Builder
newtype StmtExtraConstraint op symVarId
StmtExtraConstraint :: [Stmt op symVarId] -> StmtExtraConstraint op symVarId
[stmtMustBeAfterStmts] :: StmtExtraConstraint op symVarId -> [Stmt op symVarId]
simpleFreshStmt :: (OpTyping op SymbolicContext, GenSymSimple () symVarId) => op -> Fresh [Stmt op symVarId]
simpleFreshStmt' :: (OpTyping op SymbolicContext, GenSymSimple () symVarId) => op -> StmtExtraConstraint op symVarId -> Fresh [Stmt op symVarId]
simpleFreshStmts :: (OpTyping op SymbolicContext, GenSymSimple () symVarId) => Int -> op -> Fresh [Stmt op symVarId]
simpleFreshStmts' :: (OpTyping op SymbolicContext, GenSymSimple () symVarId) => Int -> op -> StmtExtraConstraint op symVarId -> Fresh [Stmt op symVarId]
freshStmt :: (OpTyping op SymbolicContext, Mergeable op, GenSymSimple () symVarId) => Fresh op -> Fresh [Stmt op symVarId]
freshStmt' :: (OpTyping op SymbolicContext, Mergeable op, GenSymSimple () symVarId) => Fresh op -> StmtExtraConstraint op symVarId -> Fresh [Stmt op symVarId]
freshStmts :: (OpTyping op SymbolicContext, Mergeable op, GenSymSimple () symVarId) => Int -> Fresh op -> Fresh [Stmt op symVarId]
freshStmts' :: (OpTyping op SymbolicContext, Mergeable op, GenSymSimple () symVarId) => Int -> Fresh op -> StmtExtraConstraint op symVarId -> Fresh [Stmt op symVarId]
class MkProg prog stmts op symVarId ty | prog -> stmts op symVarId ty
mkProg :: MkProg prog stmts op symVarId ty => [(Text, ty)] -> stmts -> [(symVarId, ty)] -> prog
class MkFreshProg prog stmt op symVarId ty | prog -> stmt op ty symVarId, stmt ty -> prog
mkFreshProg :: MkFreshProg prog stmt op symVarId ty => [ty] -> [Fresh [stmt]] -> [ty] -> Fresh prog
mkSimpleFreshProg :: forall op ty symVarId. (OpTyping op SymbolicContext, GenSymSimple () symVarId) => [ty] -> [op] -> [ty] -> Fresh (Prog op symVarId ty)
fromConcrete :: forall symOp symVarId symTy conOp conVarId conTy. (ToSym conTy symTy, ToSym conOp symOp, OpTyping symOp SymbolicContext, GenSymSimple () symVarId) => Prog conOp conVarId conTy -> Fresh (Prog symOp symVarId symTy)
mkSketch :: MkFreshProg prog stmt op symVarId ty => Identifier -> [ty] -> [Fresh [stmt]] -> [ty] -> prog
mkSimpleSketch :: forall op ty symVarId. (OpTyping op SymbolicContext, GenSymSimple () symVarId) => Identifier -> [ty] -> [op] -> [ty] -> Prog op symVarId ty
instance Grisette.Internal.Core.Data.Class.GenSym.GenSymSimple () symVarId => Grisette.Lib.Synth.Program.ComponentSketch.Builder.MkFreshProg (Grisette.Lib.Synth.Program.ComponentSketch.Program.Prog op symVarId ty) (Grisette.Lib.Synth.Program.ComponentSketch.Program.Stmt op symVarId) op symVarId ty
instance Grisette.Lib.Synth.Program.ComponentSketch.Builder.MkProg (Grisette.Internal.Core.Data.Class.GenSym.Fresh (Grisette.Lib.Synth.Program.ComponentSketch.Program.Prog op symVarId ty)) [Grisette.Internal.Core.Data.Class.GenSym.Fresh [Grisette.Lib.Synth.Program.ComponentSketch.Program.Stmt op symVarId]] (Grisette.Internal.Core.Data.Class.GenSym.Fresh op) (Grisette.Internal.Core.Data.Class.GenSym.Fresh symVarId) ty

data Process

type ConProgConstraint conProg conOp conVarId conType = (ConcreteVarId conVarId, conProg ~ Prog conOp conVarId conType, OpPPrint conOp, Show conOp, PPrint conType, Show conType)

[stmtResIds] :: Stmt op conVarId symVarId -> [conVarId]

[progArgType] :: ProgArg conVarId ty -> ty
data ProgRes symVarId ty

[progResType] :: ProgRes symVarId ty -> ty
data Prog op conVarId symVarId ty
